anticomplete.note: Disjoint supplied parts with no edge between them: [disjoint A & B] && ~~ neighbor A B. Empty parts qualify on every carrier; a shared K_1 singleton does not (it is only raw anticomplete), and distinct singletons of K_2 do not.

complete_between.note: Every vertex of A adjacent to every vertex of B; forces disjoint parts on an sgraph (complete_between_disjoint) and holds for empty parts. Neither part need be a clique or stable (K_1,2); not the whole-graph complete_bipartite.
